title: onboard-calypso-13b-v1.0-add-metadata-perf-profiles-and-changelog-automation
author: Priya Rao
description: Onboard Calypso-13B v1.0 to the model registry with metadata, performance profiles for supported hardware/quantization targets, and CI-driven changelog/release notes automation. Motivation: Calypso-13B is a high-priority community model requested by several customers for chat and long-context workloads (Linear ENG-4521). This PR adds the canonical metadata JSON, per-variant performance profiles (A100-40GB fp16, A10G q4_0, T4 q8_0), example inference config snippets, and a small automation step that appends a changelog entry whenever a model metadata file is added or updated. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (model-metadata/calypso-13b/v1.0.json) - [x] Add performance profile YAMLs (perf-profiles/calypso-13b/v1.0/*.yaml) - [x] Add unit tests for metadata validation (tests/test_calypso_metadata.py) - [x] Add CI workflow step to generate release notes fragment (ci/workflows/model-changelog.yml) - [x] Update registry index and docs (docs/models/calypso-13b.md) - [x] Add example inference config for Dedicated (examples/calypso/resize-batching.yaml) Implementation notes: metadata follows schema v2; perf profiles include p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s) and memory footprints measured on our internal perf-lab. The changelog automation is intentionally conservative: it generates a markdown fragment under .changelogs/models/ with metadata fields (model, version, date, short-notes) and relies on the release pipeline to aggregate fragments into a release notes rollup. See Linear ENG-4521 for rollout plan and PM-129 for customer outreach.
